To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have constructed a new class of classical solutions of the N = 6 Chern-Simons matter theories and that we have computed the degeneracy of the ground state of the solutions by quantizing the solutions' moduli.

we have constructed classical solutions for magnetic operators in the N =6 super Chern-Simons theories with unequal magnetic fluxes and we have computed the ground state degenerateities of these monopoles by explicitly quantizing their moduli.

we have found classical solutions for monopoles in N =6 Chern-Simons- matter theories with unequal magnetic fluxes in each gauge group, and that the degeneracy of the ground state of the U( 2) × U(2) monople is equal to the number of Young tableaux with two rows and a total of four boxes.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the construction of classical solutions in the context of N = 6 superconformally invariant Chern-Simons matter theories.
the classical and quantum properties of magnetic monopole solutions in N = 6 superconformally Chern-Simons theories with two gauge groups.
monopole operators of Chern-Simons theories.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the monopole operators of the U(N)×U(N) Chern- Simons theories have the same moduli spaces as the monopoles in the SU(N) gauge theory, but with a different quantization condition.
the monopoles in U(N)×U(N) theory are in 1-1 correspondence with the irreducible representations of the U(N)× U(N) global symmetry.
the ground states of U(N)×U(M) monopoles are described by the Hilbert space H (N,M) of the SU(N) × SU(M) WZNW model at level k = 1.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have found a large family of classical solutions with unequal flux contents in U(N)×U(N) gauge groups.

the ground state degeneration of the U(N)×U(N) monopole operators with magnetic flux (p, p) is given by the number of ways of partitioning the integer p into two integers q and r with 0 ≤ q ≤ p and 0 ≤ r ≤ p.

the ground states of U(N) monopoles are in one-to-one correspondence with the Young tableaux of shape (N, 1), which is the same as the ground state degeneration of the corresponding BPS Wilson loop operators.
The main takeaway from our work is that
monopole operators are semi-classical objects in Chern-Simonesque theories.
the monopole operators are not protected by supersymmetry, but rather by a combination of supersymmetry, the global symmetry of the theory, and the Chern-Simons levels.
the monopole operators can be classified by a single topological quantum number, which is the total magnetic flux.
